meta.name: Realm Remaster: new content
meta.notes: New content that has no slot in the original sheets. Bosses: the original row is phase 1; each boss here adds phase 2 and 3 idle/attack loops, the two morphs and a death clip, plus 6 shots (2 per phase). Monsters get 1 new shot each, champions 2. Shots point right; rotate in-engine. Frames sit in ext_native/ (native size) and ext_x5/ (5x with outline).
